label: The Metropolis acceptance rule
subgoals: Accept every move with zero or negative cost change
Compute e to the minus delta C over T for uphill moves
Accept the uphill move when a uniform draw falls below it

label: Evaluating a swap
subgoals: Collect the nets touching either swapped block
Recompute those nets with the blocks exchanged
Subtract the old cost from the new

label: Choosing a temperature
subgoals: Set e to the minus delta C over T equal to p
Solve T as minus delta C over ln p
Relate the temperature to typical move sizes in the schedule
